sources.citation: the documented mesh-map encodings, consulted, never copied: the curvature map is mid grey on flat surfaces, brighter on convex and darker on concave ones; the ambient occlusion map is white where unoccluded; the position map holds the bounding-box-normalised position per axis; the world space normal map holds n x 0.5 + 0.5; the thickness map is brighter where the mesh is thicker
S. Zhukov, A. Iones, G. Kronin, An ambient light illumination model, Eurographics Rendering Workshop 1998

D. S. Ebert, F. K. Musgrave, D. Peachey, K. Perlin, S. Worley, Texturing and Modeling: A Procedural Approach, 3rd ed., Morgan Kaufmann, 2003, chapter 2 (Peachey: the clamp, boxstep linear ramp and smoothstep 3t^2 - 2t^3 building blocks) and chapter 16 (Musgrave: fractional Brownian motion)
